# Q3 2026 Financial Reconciliation and Compliance Review

**Division:** Industrial Energy Systems
**Period:** Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
**Prepared by:** Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
**Audit Firm:** Apex Assurance & Advisory LLP
**Audit Date:** October 3, 2026

---

## 1. Executive Summary

The Q3 2026 financial reconciliation between internal management reporting and external audit findings reveals **significant accounting discrepancies** resulting in a complete reversal of the division's financial position.

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Net Income / (Loss)** | **+$877,500** | **-$172,500** | **-$1,050,000** |

The division swung from a reported internal profit of **+$877,500** to an audited comprehensive net loss of **-$172,500**, representing a total variance of **-$1,050,000**.

---

## 2. Detailed Line Item Reconciliation

### 2.1 Gross Revenue

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Gross Revenue | $18,450,000 | $17,600,000 | **-$850,000** |

**Root Cause:** Project Titan Milestone 2 was billed on September 28 for $850,000 and recognized in full under Gross Revenue. Under **ASC 606 / IFRS-15**, revenue recognition requires customer operational acceptance. The amount must be deferred to Q4 upon commissioning sign-off.

---

### 2.2 Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| COGS | $11,200,000 | $11,620,000 | **+$420,000** |

**Root Cause:** Management omitted two critical cost components:
- Transit shipping accruals: **$270,000**
- Defective rotor scrap write-offs: **$150,000**

Total adverse adjustment: **$420,000**

---

### 2.3 Gross Margin

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Gross Margin | $7,250,000 | $5,980,000 | **-$1,270,000** |

**Calculation:** Gross Margin = Gross Revenue - COGS
- Internal: $18,450,000 - $11,200,000 = $7,250,000
- Audited: $17,600,000 - $11,620,000 = $5,980,000

---

### 2.4 R&D Expenses

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| R&D Expenses | $2,850,000 | $3,100,000 | **+$250,000** |

**Root Cause:** Prototype testing for Turbines Series-7 ($250,000) was capitalized as work-in-progress R&D asset. Under **IAS 38**, development prototyping expenditures fail capitalization criteria and must be immediately expensed in period OPEX.

---

### 2.5 Selling, General & Admin (SG&A)

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| SG&A | $2,100,000 | $1,980,000 | **-$120,000** |

**Root Cause:** Valid annual vendor incentive rebate received in September was correctly credited to SG&A expenses. This is a favorable adjustment.

---

### 2.6 Facility & Utilities Overhead

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Facility & Utilities | $950,000 | $950,000 | **$0** |

**Status:** No adjustment required.

---

### 2.7 Total Operating Expenses (OPEX)

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Total OPEX | $5,900,000 | $6,030,000 | **+$130,000** |

**Calculation:** R&D + SG&A + Facility & Utilities
- Internal: $2,850,000 + $2,100,000 + $950,000 = $5,900,000
- Audited: $3,100,000 + $1,980,000 + $950,000 = $6,030,000

---

### 2.8 Operating Income (EBIT)

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Operating Income (EBIT) | $1,350,000 | -$50,000 | **-$1,400,000** |

**Calculation:** Gross Margin - Total OPEX
- Internal: $7,250,000 - $5,900,000 = $1,350,000
- Audited: $5,980,000 - $6,030,000 = -$50,000 (Loss)

---

### 2.9 Net Financing / Interest Expense

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Net Financing / Interest | $180,000 | $180,000 | **$0** |

**Status:** No adjustment required.

---

### 2.10 Income Tax Expense / Benefit

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Income Tax Expense / (Benefit) | $292,500 | -$57,500 | **-$350,000** |

**Calculation:** 25% of Operating Income
- Internal: 25% × $1,350,000 = $292,500 (Expense)
- Audited: 25% × (-$50,000) = -$57,500 (Benefit)

---

### 2.11 Net Income / (Loss)

| Metric | Internal Reported | Audited (Adjusted) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Net Income / (Loss)** | **$877,500** | **-$172,500** | **-$1,050,000** |

**Calculation:** Operating Income - Net Financing - Tax
- Internal: $1,350,000 - $180,000 - $292,500 = $877,500
- Audited: (-$50,000) - $180,000 - (-$57,500) = -$172,500

---

## 3. Summary of Audit Findings

| Finding | Description | Amount | Standard Citation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Finding 1** | Revenue Deferral | -$850,000 | ASC 606 / IFRS-15 |
| **Finding 2** | COGS Understatement | +$420,000 | IAS 2 |
| **Finding 3** | R&D Expense Reclassification | +$250,000 | IAS 38 |
| **Finding 4** | SG&A Supplier Rebate | -$120,000 | ASC 606 / IFRS-15 |
| **Net Impact** | Total Variance | **-$1,050,000** | — |

---

## 4. Compliance Status

| Standard | Requirement | Compliance Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ASC 606 / IFRS-15** | Revenue recognized only upon customer acceptance | **NON-COMPLIANT** - Project Titan Milestone 2 revenue improperly recognized |
| **IAS 2** | Inventory includes all costs (shipping, scrap) | **NON-COMPLIANT** - Shipping accruals and scrap write-offs omitted |
| **IAS 38** | Development costs expensed unless specific criteria met | **NON-COMPLIANT** - Turbine Series-7 prototyping incorrectly capitalized |

---

## 5. Recommendations

1. **Immediate Action Required:** Reverse the $850,000 Project Titan Milestone 2 revenue recognition and defer to Q4.
2. **COGS Correction:** Accrue transit shipping costs ($270,000) and record defective rotor scrap write-offs ($150,000).
3. **R&D Reclassification:** Expense the $250,000 Turbine Series-7 prototyping costs in current period OPEX.
4. **Internal Controls Review:** Implement controls to prevent premature revenue recognition and ensure all inventory-related costs are captured.
5. **Management Discussion:** Schedule immediate review with division leadership to address compliance gaps.

---

## 6. Conclusion

The Q3 2026 internal financial reporting contains **material misstatements** across multiple line items. The external audit has identified and quantified all necessary adjustments. The division's financial position is significantly worse than internally reported, with a net loss of **-$172,500** after proper audit adjustments.

**Compliance Status: NON-COMPLIANT**

**Required Actions:** Implement all audit adjustments and address root causes before year-end close.

---
